method: Eight fresh stock L0 cars naturally accelerate from rest with full throttle. Each starts an independent six-second measurement on reaching 100 km/h; no seeded pose/velocity. Automatic gears, production steering curve, steer from 0.5 to 4.5 seconds. One runtime candidate per car, plus adaptive throttle with a body-sideslip guard. Real RCCP OverrideInputs/Update path. Target 60 FPS, vSync off, restored afterward. Fixed-step summaries and 0.1-second traces; wheel order FL, FR, RL, RR and raw WheelHit slips. Diagnostic completion is not an acceptance pass.
tcsCandidate: Compare earlier TCS threshold 0.12 and TCS off against stock; intensity remains the valid maximum 1.
adaptiveLoop: Measurement only: s=max(0,leftRear.forwardSlip,rightRear.forwardSlip) from grounded WheelHits. If s>0.15, rearScale=Clamp01(rearScale-4*fixedDeltaTime*Clamp01((s-0.15)/0.15)); if s<0.10, rearScale=Clamp01(rearScale+0.4*fixedDeltaTime); otherwise hold. In the body-guard candidate at speed>20, target=Clamp01((7-abs(bodySlipDegrees))/4), otherwise target=1; bodyScale moves toward target at 10/s when reducing, 2/s when recovering. Combined scale=min(rearScale,bodyScale); requested throttle=demand*scale. Scales start at 1. Launch to 100 km/h uses full demand and no adaptive cut. Turn caps apply only during the 0.5..4.5s steering interval.
